fixes: Give the wood panel a distinctly dark-brown material so it contrasts against the pale stone backing; in frame-002.png and frame-006.png the panel is the same pale tan family as the stone, failing the 'dark wood' requirement.

Make the protrusion readable without moving geometry (keep the saved 0.07 m correction): add a thin dark trim/reveal or edge-shadow along the panel boundary so the 0.01 m front offset reads as the panel standing proud of the stone rather than recessed.

Capture a dedicated head-on close-range frame of the X16 north-wall door during a pre-failure traversal pass; the supplied native views (frame-002.png, frame-006.png edge-on; frame-010.png post-MISSION-FAILED) never demonstrate door readability.

Preserve all accepted connector and regression behavior unchanged (walk, world, motor, courier, failure-retry, combat, aim) — no blocking or collision regressions are visible in the supplied frames; the fix is material/depth-cue and capture only.
independent_visual_review.summary: Geometry qualification holds: the saved 0.07 m wood-panel outward correction is present in native data (panel center z=19.85 vs stone z=19.92 at x=16, wood front 0.01 m ahead of stone) with unchanged accepted inputs; all regressions pass and the accepted rough connector scope is preserved. The required visual outcome is not met, however: in frame-002.png (t=12.898 s) and frame-006.png (t=26.846 s) the X16 north-wall door reads as a pale cream slab with a similar-toned, seemingly recessed inset — the panel albedo is not dark wood and the 1 cm front offset yields no visible depth cue — and frame-010.png (t=34.996 s) shows the door only under the MISSION FAILED overlay while frame-001.png (t=10.817 s) is the AI target, not the build. Dark wood visibly ahead of pale stone is therefore not established by any supplied native frame.

cloud_evidence_annotation: The critic misidentified frame-001.png as the AI target. It is a genuine sealed native junction capture. The separate reference image is AI-generated. The original FIX is preserved; this annotation does not supply or upgrade a verdict.

continuation.decision: Retain the door correction as unaccepted working source and carry its visual findings forward. Advance the independent second-street topology scope; do not spend it on another minor material pass.
continuation.gate: Foot and vehicle must travel at least 6 m beyond the union of the previously accepted core and alley, remain outside at least 1 s, physically return without reset, have rendered support, pass all ten regressions and receive fresh scoped review.
